title: Manager / Sr Manager - Operations
description:
Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: Oversee day-to-day hospital operations and ensure smooth workflow across departments. Monitor OPD, IPD, diagnostics, patient services, and support functions. Drive operational efficiency, productivity, and service quality. Monitor KPIs, operational metrics, patient feedback, and departmental performance. Coordinate with clinical, nursing, administrative, finance, and support teams. Identify operational gaps and implement corrective and improvement measures. Ensure compliance with hospital SOPs, NABH standards, statutory requirements, and safety protocols. Manage manpower planning, resource utilization, and operational requirements. Handle patient grievances and ensure timely resolution of operational issues. Prepare MIS reports and present operational performance to senior management. Support process improvement, cost optimization, and quality initiatives. Lead and mentor operations teams to achieve organizational objectives. Qualification: 
MBA/PGDM in Hospital/Healthcare Management or equivalent qualification. 

 Key Skills 
 Operations Leadership Coordination Planning Healthcare Compliance
